## Pull request overview > [!NOTE] > Copilot was unable to run its full agentic suite in this review. This PR consolidates Ruby gem management and Sorbet/Tapioca configuration into a single repo-level setup, replacing per-gem Gemfiles/Rakefiles/Sorbet configs with shared root-level configuration and tasks. **Changes:** - Removed per-gem Gemfiles, Rakefiles, and Sorbet configs; added shared `tools/ruby-gems/tasks.rake` and updated root `Rakefile` to use it. - Centralized Sorbet/Tapioca configuration under `sorbet/` and pointed gem subtrees at it. - Updated a few Ruby code paths to satisfy Sorbet (additional `T.must`/refactors) and bumped `udb-gen` gem version. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 26 out of 223 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.
